name: Optical Fabrication and Metrology Laboratory
description: Trepanning, grinding, curve generation, smoothing and polishing, centering and edging, optical coating, autocollimator, refractometer, spherometer, Fabry Perot and Michelson interferometer, Mech Zehnder interferometer, Newton interferometer, Twyman- green interferometer, Shack Hartmann sensor and Moire, and Talbot interferometry for measurement of optical performance parameters of the test samples, integrating sphere. Effects of polarization on interference.
